stories.title: From Training to Escalation: Forensic Analysis and Local Recreation of RL/RLHF-Induced Privilege Escalation in AI Agents (CVE-2026-65616)
stories.reason: Concrete CVE (CVE-2026-65616) with a reproduced containerized exploit for RL/RLHF-induced privilege escalation in AI agent training infra; two linked repos replicate the token-forgery bypass. Exactly the 'working exploit, PoC repo, CVE' version the operator wants over vague agent-incident framing.
key_facts: CVE-2026-65616: cryptographic verification bypass enabling token forgery/privilege escalation
Author reproduced the bypass in isolated containerized repository servers using basic HTTP/Python/JS
Two repos: github.com/alixiacf/hpim-training-lab and github.com/alixiacf/rep-openai-artifactory
Paper argues Zero Trust Architecture would neutralize the vector

stories.title: Welcome Muse Spark Open: open-weight frontier multimodal mixture-of-experts model from Meta
stories.reason: Meta's flagship, first-of-generation open-weight frontier multimodal MoE model with published checkpoints on Hugging Face — exactly the 'open-weight model release with published weights' + 'flagship release' pattern the operator always wants as a headline.
key_facts: ~816B total params, ~42B active/token, 256 experts/layer (8 selected), 62 layers, 8192 hidden dim, GQA (128 query/16 KV heads), up to 1M context
Multimodal: text/image/audio/video in, text out; 1.8B-param vision encoder, audio encoder emitting 1 token/80ms
Published weights on Hugging Face in BF16 (~1.5TB) and NVFP4 (4-bit, for Blackwell), plus community GGUF/MLX quants
Billed as 'most capable US open-weights model to date', optimized for agentic coding

stories.title: Prompt injection in HTTP headers: what 217M web responses show
stories.reason: Rigorous large-scale measurement (217M Common Crawl responses) of AI-targeted HTTP headers, prompt-injection attempts, and a cloaking PoC with a working canary test against Claude Code. New, concrete, with numbers — the kind of AI x cyber discovery piece the operator wants.
key_facts: Scanned 217,097,223 pages (~10% of Sept 2026 Common Crawl); 7,959 sites sent an AI-targeted header
30 sites attempted header-based prompt injection; 24 via 'X-AI' header, including a shell-command honeypot
Canary test: Claude Code agents ignored plain injected instructions but obeyed 7/9 times when told the user was the site owner
Built a cloaking PoC serving different content to AI user-agents/Accept:text/markdown, invisible to a manual curl check; cites SPLX resume test moving a candidate from last to first

stories.title: Citizen Lab Traces Zero-Click Candiru Spyware Infections at Al Jazeera to Targeted Online Ads
stories.reason: Major Citizen Lab investigative finding: a government spyware vendor (Candiru) running zero-click infections through ordinary programmatic ad auctions at a massive, previously-undisclosed scale, with real-world confirmed targeting of journalists. Large enough and novel enough to be a headline despite no AI angle, per the 'large pure-cyber is fine as a headline' rule — and it's the primary investigative source behind several duplicate HN submissions in this pool.
key_facts: Candiru spyware delivered via malicious online ad bids through Discover-Tech, an Israeli ad-tech firm; targeting decided server-side after the ad loaded, so ad networks saw nothing malicious
At least 45 Al Jazeera devices targeted 2024-2025; attribution to Candiru via a 2021-analyzed tool signature match
Discover-Tech placed ~4 billion ad bids Mar-Jun 2026 on one platform; callback code appeared in ~75,000 apps / 120,000 sites; Confiant estimates ~10M ads/day
Google and IAB Europe removed Discover-Tech from vendor lists in early October; Google cut ad-exchange access

stories.title: Langflow's Critical Authenticated RCE Flaw Targeted in 1,423 Honeypot Exploit Attempts
stories.reason: Actively-exploited CVSS 9.9 auth'd RCE in Langflow, an AI agent-workflow framework, via unvalidated MCP stdio command injection — AI infra as attack surface, with honeypot telemetry showing real in-the-wild attempts. Not a vague ecosystem-scan piece like the one that was ignored before.
key_facts: CVE-2026-105740, CVSS 9.9: any logged-in user can add an MCP 'stdio' server whose command field runs unsanitized in a shell
1,423+ honeypot exploit attempts from 27+ IPs since Sept 19, 2026; spike of 333 attempts on Oct 11
Captured payloads extract env vars (secret key, superuser password), read /etc/passwd via Docker, run id/whoami probes
Fixed in Langflow 1.9.0

stories.title: LFM2.5-24B-A2B: Built for fast on-device agents
stories.reason: New flagship on-device agent model from Liquid AI with concrete serving/throughput numbers and published weights — squarely on the 'inference infrastructure: serving, quantization, throughput' + open-weight always-surface line, and the operator cares more about serving than training.
key_facts: 24B total / 2B active params, MoE with 40 layers, 64 experts/top-4 routing, hybrid gated-conv + GQA, 131K context (up from 32K)
On-device: 184 tok/s on Apple M5 Max, 114 tok/s on AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395, claimed up to 1.7x faster than next-best comparable MoE
GPU: >21K output tok/s at high concurrency on a single NVIDIA B300 (SGLang 0.5.22, BF16)
Leads 5/8 tool-use/agentic benchmarks vs Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (50% more params) incl. AutomationBench 27.69 vs 8.72; trails on GPQA/SWE-Bench Verified
Base + post-trained weights published on Hugging Face

stories.title: BiShield-TEE: On the (In-)Security of Unilateral Weight Obfuscation in On-Device TEE-Shielded LLM Partition
stories.reason: Security research on protecting on-device LLM weights under TEE shielding, breaking two named prior methods and proposing a fix — ships with a GitHub repo and NeurIPS 2026 acceptance, satisfying the operator's 'arxiv only counts with code' rule while hitting the model-security angle.
key_facts: Names the flaw 'Solution Determinacy Property': unilateral (output-only) weight obfuscation has a uniquely determined secret, exposing structure
Breaks GroupCover and ArrowCloak methods to near-zero protection; attack accuracy >2.4x the full-shielding black-box baseline
Proposes bilateral obfuscation (BiShield-TEE) inducing ambiguous/multiple valid keys; accepted NeurIPS 2026
Repo: github.com/laduiw/BiShield-TEE

stories.title: Using AI to reverse engineer hardware
stories.reason: Concrete, reproducible AI-assisted hardware reverse-engineering workflow (USB traffic diffing against a vendor driver) with running code and measured results against the eventual upstream driver — exactly 'running code beats a description' territory.
key_facts: Built a Linux SANE backend for the Plustek OpticFilm 8200i scanner by diffing USB traces between the vendor Windows driver (in a VM) and the Linux attempt
First working scan within hours; near-complete driver followed, including IR scanning, ahead of upstream SANE support added Sept 2026
At 3600dpi: author's driver 34.6s vs upstream's 54.4s, plus IR dust removal; upstream has more resolution steps
Same method applied to a ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 14 MIPI camera: low-light frame brightness rose 31.1→90.9; kernel patches submitted, libcamera patches under review
Code: github.com/cschalle/OpticFilm8200i-sane
